primary_source.locations: PDF p2 Table1 noise meanings; p4 Eq2-3 thresholds/confident counts; p5 Algorithm1 and Eq9-10 pruning/reweighting; 10-page proceedings PDF
primary_source.scope: PU specialization rho0=0 only; theoretical guarantees retain their population/identifiability conditions, not finite-run guarantees

source.deprecation: README recommends cleanlab; toolbox keeps the historical RP baseline, not a replacement by modern cleanlab

retained_source_behavior.confident_counts: rankpruning/rankpruning.py:99-134: mathematical threshold=positive observed-label mean, inclusive >= for confident positive; rho1=count_U_confident/count_all_confident; cap0.9999; toolbox adds explicit mean upper-bound roundoff guard
retained_source_behavior.CV_aggregation: rankpruning/rankpruning.py:211-247: estimate rates on each holdout, then mean finite per-fold rates, not pooled OOF counts
retained_source_behavior.PU_identity: rankpruning/rankpruning.py:645-681: pulearning=True forces rho0=0; general default need not be PU; toolbox always specializes to PU
retained_source_behavior.prior_inverse_noise: rankpruning/rankpruning.py:374-389: py1=ps1/(1-rho1) for rho0=0; inverse pi0 clipped0..0.9999, py1 not clipped; toolbox invalid-prior diagnostic does not become a public class prior
retained_source_behavior.strict_pruning: rankpruning/rankpruning.py:453-484: integer truncation, MIN_NUM_PER_CLASS=10, partition at k, strict > high-score U cutoff; ties retained, P untouched under pi1=0
retained_source_behavior.reweight: rankpruning/rankpruning.py:686-699: one final refit on retained rows, P weight1/(1-rho1), U weight1 under PU
retained_source_behavior.supplied_noise: rankpruning/rankpruning.py:653-678: known rho1 does not eliminate OOF predictions when probabilities are absent; toolbox still performs all internal folds

adaptation_differences: Toolbox clones the base estimator for every fold and final fit, fixes splitter random_state; source reuses self.clf and does not set StratifiedKFold random_state; not bitwise author replay
Toolbox accepts only PU observed labels and fixes rho0=0, not general two-way noisy-PN; no external precomputed probabilities or arbitrary confidence thresholds interface
Toolbox reads positive column by classes_ (including reversed order), validates finite normalized binary probabilities; source assumes [:,1]
Toolbox returns a two-column predict_proba and fixed0.5 probability prediction; source public probability is a positive vector and predict delegates to the base classifier
Default min_retained10 matches source; other explicit min_retained values are toolbox parameterizations, not approved formal search candidates

Real-valued mean cannot exceed max(P), but source np.mean can round upward on constant0.1/0.2; toolbox bounds only that overshoot by max(P), preserving >= and normal finite thresholds; source NaN-fold omission is not replayed as a new toolbox threshold mode
Only dense2D CPU interface is registered; paper CNN experiments and author Keras helper are not reproduced
